applicableDomain: Outpatient & Specialty Appointment Scheduling, Check-In & No-Show Recovery
descriptionAndPurpose: Manages provider slot templates, appointment booking against authoritative MPI patientId, arrival check-in bridging directly into OPD_CONSULTATION_FLOW and RECEPTION/TRIAGE departmental queues, and no-show recall policies.
prerequisiteConditions: Authoritative MPI lookup executed prior to booking.
Active provider schedule template with available capacity.
safetyChecks: Preserve single MPI patientId across walk-in conversion and follow-up visits.
financialAndAuthorizationPolicies: Evaluates optional consultation deposit or coverage verification via WorkflowBillingClearancePolicySpi without blocking urgent walk-ins.
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Cancellations release provider slot capacity immediately; rescheduled visits retain original referral/follow-up linkage.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: @ClinicalAudit records booking, reschedule, check-in, and no-show transitions with facilityId and actorId.
completionCriteria: Patient checked in and handed off to OPD_CONSULTATION_FLOW with encounterId created, or appointment closed/cancelled.
